title: Canonical tensor mate is compatible with etale precomposition
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $f:X\to S$ and $h=f\circ u:U\to S$ be compactifiable separated finite-type morphisms between Noetherian schemes (schemes admitting finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings), and let $u:U\to X$ be separated etale of finite type. Work in the entire ordinary derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of constant-$A$ module sheaves, with exact inverse image and derived tensor. Use the compactification-independent projections $P_f,P_h$ and the normalized unbounded compact-support composition comparison, and the right adjunctions $Rf_!\dashv f^\times$, $Rh_!\dashv h^\times$. Put $\omega_f=f^\times A_S$ and $\omega_h=h^\times A_S$. For each $K\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ define $\alpha_{f,K}:f^*K\otimes_A^L\omega_f\to f^\times K$ to be the transpose of
$$Rf_!(f^*K\otimes_A^L\omega_f)\xrightarrow{P_f}K\otimes_A^LRf_!\omega_f\xrightarrow{1\otimes\epsilon_{f,A_S}}K\otimes_A^LA_S\cong K,$$
and define $\alpha_{h,K}$ in the same way. Let $\lambda_B:u^*f^\times B\xrightarrow{\sim}h^\times B$ be the canonical comparison of right adjoints obtained from the normalized composition $Rf_!Du_!\cong Rh_!$ and the exact sum/evaluation adjunction $Du_!\dashv u^*$. Then
$$\lambda_K\circ u^*\alpha_{f,K}=\alpha_{h,K}\circ(1_{h^*K}\otimes\lambda_{A_S}),$$
where the source is identified with $h^*K\otimes_A^Lu^*\omega_f$ using the canonical inverse-image tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Under this comparison the counit for $h$ is the composite $\epsilon_{f,B}\circ Rf_!(\epsilon_{u,f^\times B})$; all formulas insert the compact-support composition identification. This holds for every unbounded $K$. The notation and functors used here are the ones in [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-kun-derived-tensor] [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] [def-amb-etale-compact-support] [def-asd-compactifiable] [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint] [lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality] [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons] [lem-amb-shriek-tensor-composition] [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] [def-weil-etale-morphism] [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring].

proof.text: Transpose both proposed tensor maps under the h adjunction and precompose by c. Naturality of c and the sum counit rewrites the first transpose, and the fold identity replaces sum extension of the tensor-pullback map. The f mate equation and projection naturality move the sum counit to the base tensor factor. Projection composition then gives the second transpose, using the composite-counit identity at the coefficient unit. Cancel c and apply injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection. This is the private, fully proved tensor_mate_calculation specialized in the item.

lean.note: Returned-head repair: restores the original natural-language statement, including the actual tensor-mate equality and the sum/evaluation counit. The helper is the canonical right mate of etaleAmbientLeftComparison against the degreewise sum adjunction and the exceptional adjunction. The normalized comparison family N has the graph-section and representative characterizations of EtaleCompactSupportNormalization, whose existence is already stated; the assertion holds for every such family. The two alpha maps are written as explicit adjunction transposes, avoiding a duplicate of the downstream smoothTensorDualityMap definition and an import cycle with thm-asd-smooth-tensor. No arbitrary exceptional comparison or extra adjoint-existence hypothesis is imposed.
